text: {"fixed_clause": "Upon termination of this Agreement, the Vendor shall archive all operational data and records in a secure repository for historical analysis and business intelligence purposes, maintaining such records only as long as necessary for those purposes or required by applicable legal retention requirements, unless otherwise agreed in a separate commercial amendment."}

data.fixed_clause: Upon termination of this Agreement, the Vendor shall archive all operational data and records in a secure repository for historical analysis and business intelligence purposes, maintaining such records only as long as necessary for those purposes or required by applicable legal retention requirements, unless otherwise agreed in a separate commercial amendment.
